title: Marketing Manager
must_have: 3+ years of experience in digital marketing
text:
Marketing Manager
Lotus Brand Studio | Full-time | Hybrid, India

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are hiring a marketing manager to join our digital marketing team. You will work with cross-functional partners and own outcomes end to end.

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS:
- Google Analytics
- Social Media Marketing
- Email Marketing
- Campaign Management
- Content Strategy
- 3+ years of experience in digital marketing

NICE-TO-HAVE:
- Copywriting
- Marketing Automation
- A/B Testing
- HubSpot

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Drive regional expansion push with measurable outcomes.
- Drive customer acquisition drive with measurable outcomes.
- Drive product relaunch with measurable outcomes.
